_comment: Fork this file per watch. Point savedSearch.id at your own Meltwater saved search for the brand/topic you're monitoring, and firstParty at your own internal source. Nothing here is account-specific — 'Northwind Appliances' is a fictional demo brand.
name: Northwind Appliances — product safety signal
_savedSearch_note: Replace with your real Meltwater saved-search id (the authority on relevance; the agent queries it with query:'*'). If omitted, the agent falls back to unified_retrieval_query_gen_tool on the topic name — fine to start, but a saved search gives a cleaner dataset.
_firstParty_note: Swap for a connector to your real internal system (CRM, support desk, claims…). It runs in YOUR process via client-side MCP, so a private/internal URL is reachable and never exposed publicly.
_asOf_note: null = today (real-time). Set an ISO date (or pass --as-of YYYY-MM-DD) to anchor the scan to a specific day — for backfilling a missed run, replaying an incident, or a demo with a known spike. The alert labels the as-of date.
